content: Hypothesis fuzzy anchoring: multiple selectors per target (range/XPath, text-position, text-quote with 32-char surrounding context), cascading fallback: structural selector -> position -> context-aware fuzzy match -> simple fuzzy match. Robust-anchoring literature (MSR keyword anchoring, US7747943B2) confirms multi-attribute matching + graceful degradation as the established pattern; validates TD-01's content-hash + heading-path + ordinal attribute matching with confidence-tiered fallback.
